scope: Offline CPython with Ignition/Java API fakes; not a live Ignition verification

A new heartbeat restores freshness

Good quality recovery restores telemetry use with a changing heartbeat
Bad heartbeat quality invalidates the previous freshness baseline
Recovery requires a change between good heartbeat samples
The next good heartbeat change completes recovery
Model validity is independent of healthy communication and a changing heartbeat

Health summary explains the valid isolated state
The independent watchdog expires when the Gateway timer stops running
Summary does not display a frozen healthy message after timer failure

A NaN numeric value is rejected even when its OPC quality says Good
A infinite numeric value is rejected even when its OPC quality says Good

Out-of-range or fractional heartbeat 65536 is rejected
Out-of-range or fractional heartbeat 1.5 is rejected

Read error details remain visible

Read-exception recovery completes on the next observed change
